Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by subquery/subquery-component-library (https://github.com/subquery/subquery-component-library).
Technology stack: react, typescript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 简报里的 subquery/react-ui 与 @subql/components 那条最后都落到 subquery/subquery-component-library 同一页。README 标题写 SubQuery React UI libray（原文拼写），Features 两条分别是 A React components lib based on antd and Subquery design system out of the box 与 Shared reusable components across Subquery apps；Developing 一节就两行 yarn 和 yarn storybook，说明 Storybook 是主要开发入口。根目录 rollup.config.js 的提交写 feat: chatbox、feat: part rollup compile，docs/ 那条写 feat: update theme blue，另有 components/ 目录。许可证 GPL-3.0，8 位贡献者，27 个分支，0 个 release。
